images.name: 01-overview
images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: Chrome Web Store global screenshot, 1280x800 canvas, landscape 16:10, opaque.
Adapt the reference promo to this 1280x800 screenshot canvas. Preserve its exact approved design, branching-node logo, pale lavender background, restrained light blue diagonal sweep at bottom-right, small pink upper-right corner, dark purple rounded UI card on right, bold Chinese typography on left. Keep all content comfortably inside 60px margins. Keep the composition close to reference, with cleaner sharp legible text.
Exact text left: brand "幕布导出工具"; headline two lines "幕布笔记" and "一键导出"; supporting "批量导出 · 保留目录"; pill "7 种导出格式".
Right panel heading "导出格式" and exactly seven rows "Markdown", "OPML", "FreeMind", "HTML", "Word", "PDF", "JSON", each with a small clean line icon. Match original card, white labels and purple selected row.
No new claims, no additional text, no browser chrome, no watermark. This is overview image 1 in a consistent five-image marketing series.

images.name: 02-feat1-formats
images.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / style-transfer.
Create one Chrome Web Store feature screenshot, 1280x800 landscape 16:10 opaque. This is feature 1 of a consistent campaign. Image 1 is the approved STYLE reference: same pale lavender background, small pink upper right corner, pastel blue diagonal lower right sweep, black branching-node logo in white rounded square, deep ink-purple titles, vivid purple emphasis, dark purple product UI cards, soft subtle shadows, crisp large Chinese typography. Image 2 is FUNCTION reference only: Mubu Exporter format dropdown. Replace its old saturated blue/pink design entirely.
Composition: logo and brand "幕布导出工具" top left, a left text column occupying 45%, right a large dark rounded popup-style product panel occupying 45%; generous margins. Same design language and relative type scale as image1.
Left headline two lines, exactly "多种格式" (dark) and "自由导出" (purple), purple curved underline. Supporting copy exactly "笔记、大纲、文档，按需选择". A compact 2-row group of seven format chips beneath, texts ".md" ".opml" ".mm" ".html" ".doc" ".pdf" ".json".
Right panel brand icon and heading "导出格式"; an expanded dropdown with exactly 7 rows, clearly readable and aligned: "Markdown (.md)", "OPML (.opml)", "FreeMind (.mm)", "HTML (.html)", "Word (.doc)", "PDF (.pdf)", "JSON (.json)". First row selected in purple, small tidy corresponding line icons. No clipped or missing rows. UI should closely resemble source dark dropdown but polished and legible for promotional use.
Do not reuse the overview headline. No unsupported claims, no stars, no watermark, no other text, no 3D or decorative people.

images.name: 03-feat2-batch-export
images.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / style-transfer.
Create one Chrome Web Store feature screenshot, 1280x800 landscape 16:10 opaque. Image 1 is approved STYLE reference; image 2 is FUNCTION reference showing Mubu Exporter batch export popup. Replace its old blue/pink design entirely. Match image1: pale lavender backdrop, small pink upper-right corner, soft blue diagonal sweep at lower-right, branching-node logo in white rounded square, bold dark purple Chinese headings with vivid purple second line and curved underline, deep purple rounded UI panel, subtle shadows.
Composition: brand logo and "幕布导出工具" upper left; left text 45%, dark product panel on right 45%; safe margins 60px.
Headline left exactly two lines: "批量导出" (dark) / "轻松备份" (purple). Supporting text "全部导出，或只选需要的内容". Beneath it a clean vertical two-step instruction: circle "1" label "获取文件信息"; circle "2" label "选择格式并导出". Small caption below "登录幕布后即可使用".
Right panel faithful simplified popup UI: logo top then "幕布导出工具", label "导出格式", dropdown "Markdown (.md)", full-width purple button "获取文件信息", full-width outlined purple button "全量导出", then smaller text-link action "选择导出内容". Beneath actions show a compact inset folder-tree preview with lavender folder icons, documents and checked boxes, labels "工作笔记", "项目计划", "会议记录", "学习笔记". Folder items visually clear. Keep actions legible, panel balanced; do not put unsupported UI controls or statistics in it. Modern clean Chinese sans-serif, few clear elements.
No time-saving claims, no rating or review text, no extra formats list, no watermark, no people or 3D.

images.name: 04-feat3-settings
images.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / style-transfer.
Create one Chrome Web Store feature introduction screenshot, landscape 1280x800 16:10 opaque. Image1 is STYLE reference and image2 FUNCTION reference for real Mubu Exporter general settings. Replace old electric blue/pink style with EXACT cohesive campaign look: pale lavender background, small pink upper-right corner, soft blue diagonal sweep bottom right, bold deep-purple Chinese headline with vivid purple emphasis and curved lavender underline, rounded dark-purple product panel, soft shadows, black branching-node icon in white rounded square. No people or 3D.
Layout: brand logo + "幕布导出工具" upper left. Left column 38%, right panel 54%, all 60px safe margins. Left headline exactly two lines "备份目录" in dark ink, "自己定义" in purple. Supporting text on two short lines "自定义下载子文件夹" / "保留原有目录层级". Below, a subtle pill "文件归档更有条理".
Right: elegant dark settings window, wide enough to include left navigation sidebar and main content. Sidebar small brand icon; nav labels "通用设置" (purple selected), "选择导出内容", "性能监控", "关于". Main heading "通用设置". Main content card title "下载子文件夹", field containing "我的幕布备份", brief readable helper "保存在浏览器的下载目录内". Below separate inset preview panel heading "目录示意", tree with lavender folder icons: "下载" > "我的幕布备份" > folders "工作笔记" and "学习笔记". Place a clear "打开下载设置" outlined button below the preview. Use generous space and crisp readable text. Do not show arbitrary absolute folder paths or Browse Folder chooser. This feature defines a subfolder inside Chrome Downloads, not any absolute backup destination. Do not invent scheduled backups, cloud sync or account controls.
No extra claims, no watermark, no extra paragraphs. Maintain same rounded card styling, typography and palette as approved reference.

images.name: 05-feat4-performance
images.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / style-transfer.
Create one Chrome Web Store feature screenshot, opaque 1280x800 landscape 16:10. Image1 is approved STYLE reference; image2 FUNCTION reference: performance monitoring and download details in Mubu Exporter. Replace old saturated blue/pink styling entirely. Match campaign: pale lavender background, soft blue diagonal lower-right sweep and small pink top-right corner, branching-node logo in white rounded square, bold ink-purple Chinese titles, vivid purple emphasis with lavender curved underline, dark rounded product UI card and restrained shadows.
Layout brand icon + "幕布导出工具" upper left. Left column 35%, right settings window 59%, safe margins at least 48px. Left exact headline two lines "导出进度" (dark) / "一目了然" (purple). Supporting lines "文件状态随时查看" / "下载详情清晰呈现". Below two subtle pills stacked, "按状态筛选" and "查看耗时详情".
Right large dark purple settings window faithful simplified performance page. Left nav "通用设置", "选择导出内容", "性能监控" selected purple, "关于". Main heading "性能监控". Main first card heading "下载详情（文件树）". Below filter tabs "全部" (selected), "成功", "失败", "处理中". Tree example folder "工作笔记" with lavender folder icon, children "项目计划.md" green check and "成功", "会议记录.md" green check and "成功", "学习笔记.md" small spinner and "处理中". These are clearly sample document names, no absolute success promises. Second smaller card heading "下载最慢的 10 个文件", show two simple rows of the same example completed filenames with understated horizontal purple timing bars, do NOT add invented timing numbers or percent claims. Clear typography, simplified UI showing real feature concepts, no dense tiny unreadable text.
No CPU charts or fake analytics. No 100%, no cloud upload, no speed guarantee, no watermark, no decorative people or 3D. Keep all text properly spelled and comfortably readable.
